scripts.text:
[Girl]
You're not ready.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey? Stop!
Aren't you interested in hearing a funny story?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿？停下！
你不想知道一个有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you have any interest... just go!
Do you know where the guild is?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
如果你感兴趣的话...那就去吧！
你知道公会在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Wow, you look busy.
Have you heard that there are visiters?
They're on a treasure hunt!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哇，你看起来很忙。
你听说有访客来了吗？
他们正在寻宝！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Eh?
I don't have anything for you...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
呃？
我没有什么给你的...

scripts.text: What story?
scripts.translation: 什么故事？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Have you been to the guild recently?
Some interesting things have happened lately.
Maybe new guests...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你最近去过公会吗？
最近发生了一些有趣的事情。
也许是新来的客人...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I heard it has to do with something called a Shadow Chaser.
You should go and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我听说这和一种叫做逐影猎人的东西有关。
你应该去看看。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Every time they visit us, they are on new missions.
What missions are they doing I wonder?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
每次他们来访，都有新的任务。
不知道他们在执行什么任务呢？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
It is in a fortress under Pharos lighthouse.
Sigh....
You must visit there!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
它在发乐斯灯塔岛下面的堡垒里。
唉...
你一定要去那里看看！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
It must be fun.
I wanna try!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
那一定很有趣。
我想去试试！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey? Stop!
Aren't you interested in hearing a funny story?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿？停下！
你不想知道一个有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Ah? What's this?
Lotte, you know what this means?
scripts.translation:
[文]
啊？这是什么？
洛特，你知道这意味着什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Hmm '3847147298' this is the only thing I've used on...
Then, why'd they use numbers to name the villages?
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
嗯，'3847147298' 这是我唯一用过的...
那么，为什么他们用数字来命名村庄呢？

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Vin! This is crap!
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
文！这太糟糕了！

scripts.text:
[Vin]
What?
scripts.translation:
[文]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Hey there?
scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
嘿，那里？

scripts.text: Me?
scripts.translation: 我吗？

scripts.text: Sorry, I am busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙...

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Yes! You there!
Let me introduce myself to you.
My name is Urupa.
If you are interested, could you come over here?
scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
是的！就是你！
让我向你介绍一下自己。
我的名字是乌鲁帕。
如果你感兴趣，能过来一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
What? You're just going to give up like that?
So disappointing...
scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
什么？你就要这样放弃吗？
真令人失望...

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
You are supposed to figure this one out!
But you are still so... weak.
scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
你应该能解开这个谜题的！
但你还是太...弱了。

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Yes...
Sooner or later I'll solve it myself if I dare to get the map...!
scripts.translation:
[文]
是的...
迟早我会自己解开它的，只要我敢去拿那张地图...！

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Huh! This is a Shadow Chaser!
How unbelievable!
But it seems familiar doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[文]
哈！这是一个逐影猎人！
真是难以置信！
但感觉有点熟悉，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Hmm......
..........
Oh my! I can't remember...!

[Vin]
Ah? Who's there?
We are flooded with guests today...
scripts.translation:
[文]
啊？是谁？
今天客人真多啊...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
What?
Damn...
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
什么？
该死...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
I just hate numbers!
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
我最讨厌数字了！

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Wow!
You are the one!
Just extraordinary smart and emotionally advanced...
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
哇！
就是你！
真是聪明绝顶，情商又高...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
SHADOW CHASER!
Wow when could I become one.
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
逐影猎人！
哇，我什么时候才能成为那样的人啊。

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
I don't need anything.
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
我什么都不需要。

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Oh you are so talented?
Now I have one interesting quetion! Do you want it solved?
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
哦，你很有天赋吗？
那我有一个有趣的问题！你想解开它吗？

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
My name is Urupa.
If you have anything interesting just challenge it.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
我的名字是乌鲁帕。
如果你有什么有趣的事，尽管来挑战吧。

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
What's your business?
I don't have anything to do with you.
I don't care for people like you. I just deal with the extraordinary.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
你找我有何贵干？
我跟你没什么关系。
我不喜欢像你这样的人。我只跟非凡的人打交道。

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
We give a quiz and nobody has yet to solve it.
You want it to be solved?
This is a code.
Look at it.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
我们出了一个谜题，至今无人能解。
你想解开它吗？
这是一个密码。
看看这个。

scripts.text:
- The message is -
- written in a cipher. -
The mission seems to be to break the code...
scripts.translation:
- 这条信息 -
- 是用密码写成的。 -
任务似乎是破解这个密码...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
This is the code.
It is just numbering a cipher to make the message make sense.
For example...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
这是密码。
它只是给密码编号，让信息变得有意义。
例如...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Now here's what needs to be to solved.
Decipher the code and go where it tells you...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
现在，这里是需要解开的部分。
破解密码，然后去它告诉你的地方...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
So write this down!
I expected that you would take this adventure!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
所以把这个记下来！
我预料到你会接受这个冒险！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
You want one more explanation?
Or do you just want the code?
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
你想再听一次解释？
还是直接要密码？

scripts.text: More explanation.
scripts.translation: 再解释一下

scripts.text: Get the code.
scripts.translation: 获取密码

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Now it's up to you!
So go! Go!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
现在就看你的了！
去吧！快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Let me show you the code again...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
让我再给你展示一次密码...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Ok, have you solved it yet?
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
好了，你解出来了吗？
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
You have just become a Shadow Chaser.
The quizzes are for collecting the right people...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
你刚刚成为了一名逐影猎人。
这些测验是为了筛选出合适的人...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Nothing special?
As you see... I am ok here!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
没什么特别的？
你看...我在这里挺好的！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
3511543433
This means PAYON.

[Urupa]
The numbers have to be paired.
3511543433
35 11 54 34 33 breaks down into 5 pairs!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
数字必须两两配对。
3511543433
35 11 54 34 33 可以拆分为5对！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
So the pairs mean:
35 - P, 11 - A,
54 - Y, 34 - O, 33 - N.

[Urupa]
Here are the numbers all in a row.
33, 34, 35!
N , O , P ?
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
这里有一排数字。
33, 34, 35!
N , O , P ?

scripts.text: Here we go!
scripts.translation: 开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Could you do that?
If you visit there, you might be surprised...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
你能做到吗？
如果你去那里看看，可能会大吃一惊...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Where's Max!?
Damn, there're so many strangers around.
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
麦克斯在哪里！？
该死，周围全是陌生人。
嘿...

scripts.text: Show the deciphered code!
scripts.translation: 展示破解后的密码！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Wow, you deciphered it?
So, what's the right answer?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
哇，你破解出来了？
那么，正确答案是什么？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Good.
You just got it.
Then why have you come over here?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
很好。
你答对了。
那你为什么来这里？

scripts.text: The code says here's the one...
scripts.translation: 密码说这里就是...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
So you are the one.
Could you wait for a sec'?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
原来你就是那个人。
能稍等一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Remember to put the code exactly as it should be deciphered.
Maybe you should try again...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
记得把密码完全按照破解后的样子填写。
也许你应该再试一次...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Only allowed for people involved....
Could you ask the clerk at the shop?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
仅限相关人员使用...
你能去问问商店的店员吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now let me introduce myself to you!
I am Graham, the manager of this shadow gallery...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
现在让我正式介绍一下自己！
我是格雷厄姆，这家地下画廊的管理员...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You may have already guessed.
This is an additional facility for rogues.
We adopt things like art and other historical stuff.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你可能已经猜到了。
这是为流氓准备的额外设施。
我们收藏艺术品和其他历史文物。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
These things are illegal.
Such things you guys bring us from historical places...
Ok.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这些东西是非法的。
你们从历史遗迹带回来的那些东西...
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
So we've got to know things like...
special codes and information where the treasures are.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
所以我们必须掌握一些信息...
比如特殊的密码，以及宝物藏在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
We need you guys...
So we've asked assistance from the Rogue guild.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我们需要你们...
所以我们向流氓公会寻求了援助。

scripts.text: Any other places you guys work?
scripts.translation: 你们还在其他地方有业务吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ah, yes...
We are in Prontera, Juno, Rachel, and Lighthalzen.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
啊，是的...
我们在普隆德拉、朱诺、拉赫和里希塔乐镇都有据点。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Anyway....
We all really want to know where the treasures are.
So the code is to break into each of those places.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
总之....
我们都非常想知道宝物在哪里。
所以密码就是用来潜入那些地方的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You seem like the right one.
So I will give you the code.
Please find the treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你看起来就是合适的人选。
所以我会把密码给你。
请找到宝物！

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 绝对不行！

scripts.text: I'll give it a try!
scripts.translation: 我会试试看的！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
What the hell?
If you are not going to help then I'll just find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
该死的？
如果你不打算帮忙，我就去找别人了。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are so powerful!
So here...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真的很厉害！
那么这里...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Are you interested in it now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你现在感兴趣了吗？

scripts.text: Not at all.
scripts.translation: 一点都不喜欢。

scripts.text: Hmm, I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我收下。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Damn it.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
该死的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are just so picky...
Here...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是挑剔...
这里...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你找到什么东西了吗？

scripts.text: I need an explanation.
scripts.translation: 我需要解释一下。

scripts.text: What's the code again?
scripts.translation: 密码是什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are so powerful!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是厉害！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
I've given you the code.
So crazy...
Don't you have a memo of it?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我已经把密码给你了。
真是疯了...
你没有备忘录吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Nothing special...?
You've been to places...?
There's definetely something.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
没什么特别的...？
你去过那些地方...？
肯定有什么东西。

scripts.text:
Graham seems to know something.
I'd better go there again.
scripts.translation:
格雷厄姆似乎知道些什么。
我最好再去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
So, any improvements?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
那么，有什么进展吗？

scripts.text: Show him the key.
scripts.translation: 给他看钥匙

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Deception!
You are deceiving me!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
欺骗！
你在欺骗我！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is all?
Only one key.
How deceptive!
Just as I thought, it's a kind of treasure.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
就这些？
只有一把钥匙。
真是狡猾！
果然，这是一种宝物。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You just gave me a shock.
Ok...
The code is kept in galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是吓了我一跳。
好吧...
密码保存在画廊里。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok there's more galleries than this one...
Juno and Rachel have the codes...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
好吧，画廊不止这一家...
朱诺和拉赫那里有密码...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is just what I was guessing.
The codes kept by other galleries aren't treasures at all...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这正如我所料。
其他画廊保存的密码根本不是宝物...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去拉赫...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Find the gallery in Rachel...
Tell 'em that you just came from Graham and ask for the code.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
找到拉赫的画廊...
告诉他们你是格雷厄姆派来的，然后索要密码。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok?
Then go there!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
明白了吗？
那就去吧！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
There're four galleries...
Prontera, Rachel, Juno, and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
一共有四家画廊...
普隆德拉、拉赫、朱诺，还有里希塔乐镇。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
One of the codes kept by the galleries is already deciphered.
It's just one key....
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
画廊保存的密码中，已经有一个被破解了。
它只是一把钥匙....

scripts.text:
[Graham]
But here's what I am guessing.
The codes are linked to each other.
And the purpose is different for each one.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
但我猜测是这样的。
这些密码是相互关联的。
而且每一个的用途都不同。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
For example...
If one is just a key then the others are things requiring the key.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
举个例子...
如果一个是钥匙，那么其他的就需要这把钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
The key must be for opening the box.
Can you guess what's inside?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这把钥匙肯定是用来打开箱子的。
你能猜到里面是什么吗？

scripts.text: Umm, treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯，是宝物？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
YES.
That's why we're here!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
没错。
这就是我们在这里的原因！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
People think that we are just trading the stuff...
But we are here for very special things.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
人们以为我们只是在交易货物...
但我们是为了非常特别的东西而来的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to ^4d4dffRachel Gallery^000000 and get the code...
They will support you if you explain everything.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去^4d4dff拉赫画廊^000000获取密码...
如果你把情况解释清楚，他们会支持你的。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How about everything?
We are dying to know about the key.
So you got support from the other galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
关于一切，你觉得怎么样？
我们迫切地想知道关于钥匙的事。
所以你获得了其他画廊的支持。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Shadow Chaser!!
Ah!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
逐影猎人！！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
It's not intentionally decieving...
Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这不是故意欺骗...
哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Isn't it interesting?
It's more than just taking exams.
We got to know about you and figured out who you are.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这不是很有趣吗？
这不仅仅是考试。
我们了解了你，并弄清了你是谁。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How's my acting?
It worked?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我的演技如何？
起作用了吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
If you need anything just ask them what you want.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
如果你需要什么，直接问他们你要什么。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Only allowed for people involved...
Could you ask the clerk at the shop?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
仅限相关人员...
你能问问商店的职员吗？

scripts.text: These are just numbers...
scripts.translation: 这些只是数字...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
The only difference from the one from the Rogue Guild is that you don't need to match them in pairs.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
与流氓公会的那个唯一的区别是，你不需要将它们配对。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Also here's the keyword...
This case is key 0.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
另外这是关键词...
这个案例是 key 0。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Let's see. For example.
13 15 18 15 3 3 18 21 9 14 =
M O R O C C R U I N
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
让我们看看。例如。
13 15 18 15 3 3 18 21 9 14 =
M O R O C C R U I N

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Look at this... C = 3.
C is the third letter right?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
看这个... C = 3。
C是第三个字母，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Graham]

Shadow workplace in Lighthalzen.
The manager's name is Vicente.
Tell him everything and get one last information.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
里希塔乐镇的影子工作场所。
管理员的名字是维森特。
告诉他一切，并获取最后一条资讯。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hey, you!
Was Vicente helpful to you?
You have something important...
So you have to find out what is it.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嘿，你！
维森特对你有帮助吗？
你身上有重要的东西...
所以你必须弄清楚那是什么。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Keep trying.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
继续尝试。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hey, you!
What's going on?
What? Shadow Chaser?
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嘿，你！
发生什么事了？
什么？逐影猎人？

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Did I know that fact?
Sure. I heard a little bit before
I used to do work like this.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我知道这个事实吗？
当然。我之前听说过一点。
我以前也做过类似的工作。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
It's an honor for me to pick a person who belongs to us.
Just accept that. You are going to be a good Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
能挑选一位属于我们的人，是我的荣幸。
就接受这个事实吧。你会成为一名优秀的逐影猎人。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
I like your face.
We don't have any special thing.
An assistant sells some paint and tool.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我喜欢你的脸。
我们这里没有什么特别的东西。
助手卖一些颜料和工具。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Paul said...

[Haled]
Ekk... He...
Knew everything...
Hmm...
I can help.
I will cooperate.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
呃...他...
什么都知道...
嗯...
我可以帮忙。
我会配合的。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
I need some time to collect my thoughts.
Wait for me a bit.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我需要一点时间整理思绪。
等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
You are?
Sorry, but we don't trade old art goods.
If you neeed something, then ask an assistant.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
你是？
抱歉，我们不交易旧艺术品。
如果你需要什么，请询问助手。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome.
I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
欢迎光临。
我一直在等你。

scripts.text: For me?
scripts.translation: 给我？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I wondered when you would visit.
I've been waiting a long time for you.
Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我猜你什么时候会来。
我等你很久了。
呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
How were Graham,Paul and Haled?
They are not easy people to deal with huh?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
格雷厄姆、保罗和哈雷德怎么样？
他们应该不好对付吧？

scripts.text: You know everything?
scripts.translation: 你全都知道？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Sure.
They ignore me because they think that I'm too young.
As if they were all perfect. HahahaHah...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
当然。
他们无视我，觉得我太年轻了。
好像他们都很完美似的。哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Did you bring all of the keys?
There should be three.
You came here to find out how to use them I assume, right?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你把所有的钥匙都带来了吗？
应该有把。
我猜你是来这里想知道怎么使用它们的，对吧？

scripts.text: Yeah, you're right!
scripts.translation: 没错，你猜对了！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You don't have to be surprised.
I can't find how long it took for those three men to investigate before.
I already finished my work.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你不必惊讶。
我甚至不知道那三个人之前花了多少时间进行调查。
我已经完成我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
When I went to the final location I found a stone statue.
But it needs to have key.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
当我到达最终地点时，我发现了一尊石像。
但它需要钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Even Three.
 
(Vicente smiles)
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
甚至需要三把。

(维森特微笑)

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
At first, the information that was given from the guild means only one thing.
Because of the saying that they respect the right of our possessions,
we shared our information.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
起初，公会提供的资讯只意味着一件事。
因为他们尊重我们对物品的所有权，
所以我们共享了资讯。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So we had to wait for it.
I thought the last man would never give it to me...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
所以我们不得不等待。
我以为最后那个人永远不会把它给我...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
They thought I wanted to have the treasure for myself.
So that's why I've just been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
他们以为我想把宝物据为己有。
所以我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Then let's make a point!
Do you know thanatos tower?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
那么让我们进入正题！
你知道达纳托斯塔吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: The tower of death?
scripts.translation: 死亡之塔？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You know that.
Then you can understand easily.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你知道的。
那你应该很容易理解。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Yes, that tower in northen Juno.
There are huge monsters there.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
是的，朱诺北边的那座塔。
那里有巨大的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You told me that you went to the final place with the information?
That's the Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你告诉我，你带着资讯去了最终地点？
那就是达纳托斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Fortunately, the location is the 1st floor of that tower.
So I'm going to tell what you have to do.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
幸运的是，地点在那座塔的一楼。
所以我要告诉你该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
At the 1st floor of thanatos tower, there are members from the Rekenber Corporation.
Go north from their desk...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
在达纳托斯塔的一楼，有雷肯贝尔公司的成员。
从他们的办公桌往北走...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And you can find stairs and a location where light comes out of.
That's the location of the information that I have.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你会找到楼梯和一个有光线射出的地方。
那就是我拥有的资讯所在的位置。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Now you know the location you have to go to with the three keys.
Find out the secret of the stone statue.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
现在你知道带着三把钥匙要去的地方了。
解开石像的秘密吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You can't imagine what kind of things you might find.
That's the final destination of all of the keys.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你无法想象那里可能藏着什么样的东西。
那是所有钥匙的最终目的地。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Listen carefully.
The location you need to find is
north from middle of thanatos 1st floor.
You can find stairs and a location where light comes out.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
仔细听好。
你需要找的地方在达纳托斯塔一楼中央的北边。
你会看到楼梯和一个有光线射出的地方。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you find something, come back here.
Actually, I want to get the key from you, but...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
如果你找到了什么，就回来这里。
其实，我想从你那里拿走钥匙，但是...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I just respect your opinion.
If you find something, come back here. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我只是尊重你的意见。
如果你找到了什么，就回来这里。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are back?
Find anything?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你回来了？
找到什么了吗？

scripts.text: Throw the brush.
scripts.translation: 扔出刷子

scripts.text: Grab him by the collar.
scripts.translation: 抓住他的衣领

scripts.text: Drop the brush.
scripts.translation: 放下刷子

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hey, what are you doing?
This brush...
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嘿，你在做什么？
这把刷子...
这就是藏在达纳托斯塔的宝物吗？

scripts.text: Vicente looks surprised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 维森特看了一眼后，露出了惊讶的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
What's wrong with you?
You can tell me more details?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你怎么了？
能告诉我更多细节吗？

scripts.text: Vincente looks surpised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 维森特看了一眼后，露出了惊讶的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这就是藏在达纳托斯塔的宝物吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
What the matter?
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
怎么了？
你没事吧？

scripts.text: Vicente looks at me with a surprised face.
scripts.translation: 维森特用惊讶的眼神看着我。

scripts.text: Point at the brush.
scripts.translation: 指向刷子

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这就是藏在达纳托斯塔的宝物吗？

scripts.text: Vincente looks surpised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 维森特看了一眼后，露出了惊讶的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha!!
Ahahahaha!!!!!
I got it now!
Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈！！
啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
我懂了！
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
It's treasure.
You found a big treasure!
Talk to me for bit, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这是宝物。
你找到了一个大宝物！
跟我聊一会儿，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
There is someone who has been waiting for you.
He's been waiting for someone to bring this brush back.
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
有个人一直在等你。
他一直在等有人把这把刷子带回来。
我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm going to listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我要听听你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm expecting your work from now on.
You must be a good Shadow Chaser.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
从现在开始，我期待你的表现。
你一定是个优秀的逐影猎人。
我对此深信不疑。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you don't have anything special to do here, you'd better leave.
No trespassing.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
如果你在这里没什么特别的事，最好离开。
禁止擅闯。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This way.
He's been waiting for you a while.
Not me, Dumk.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这边请。
他等你很久了。
不是我，是邓克。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Dumk wants to have you as a Shadow Chaser.
Big news right?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
邓克想让你成为逐影猎人。
这可是个大新闻，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm expecting your work from now on.
You must be a good Shadow Chaser.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
从现在开始，我期待你的表现。
你一定是个优秀的逐影猎人。
我对此深信不疑。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I don't have any special reason to visit here.
An assistant sells tools and paint.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我来这里没有特别的原因。
助手在卖工具和颜料。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What is it?
Have you been enjoying your new skills?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
怎么了？
你的新技能用得还顺手吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
If you want to improve your skills, you have to seek out new uses for paint.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
如果你想提升技能，就必须去探索颜料的新用途。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't forget.
We are Shadow Chasers.
Huhu...
HuhuHuhu...
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
别忘了。
我们是逐影猎人。
呼呼...
呼呼呼呼...

scripts.text: - You can't continue on in this quest because you are overweight. -
scripts.translation: - 因为你超重了，无法继续这个任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Who is this guy? Why should he sit in front of me so high?
Although I do not know why you riding on it, but here is in door,
That is no danger to rely on animals to escape, so you please get down!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这家伙是谁？为什么坐得比我高？
虽然我不知道你为什么骑在上面，但这里是室内，
靠动物逃跑毫无危险可言，所以请下来！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Vicente. No Soliciting.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
维森特。禁止推销。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
A solicitor?
I don't think so. He's our colleage.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
推销员？
我不这么认为。他是我们的同事。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
...Ah?

[Dumk]
You are still green!
Did you expect that you can learn the dark arts with your ability?
You are wrong!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你还是个新手！
你以为凭你的能力就能学会黑暗艺术吗？
你错了！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha...
Please, understand. Dumk has very bad communication skills.
Even doesn't talk to anyone who isn't a high enough level.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈...
请多包涵。邓克的沟通能力很差。
他甚至不跟等级不够高的人说话。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And as person who isn't not ready.
^4d4dffYou maybe are not ready for him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
而且对于还没准备好的人来说，
^4d4dff你可能还没准备好面对他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You talk too much.
Heh.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你话太多了。
哼。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
- He is pleased. -
Hey.
He could be ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
- 他很高兴。 -
嘿。
他可能会感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's you? You are the one who found the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
是你吗？你就是找到那把刷子的人？

scripts.text: Show the brush to him.
scripts.translation: 把刷子给他看

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
That's it.
Did you find it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
就是这把。
是你自己找到的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: With my friends
scripts.translation: 和朋友一起

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
You have a high ability.
Breaking the codes should have been tough.
But it wasn't for you.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嗯...
你的能力很高。
破解密码应该很困难。
但对你来说并不是这样。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
That's your other skill.
People who have no friends must be lonely.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嗯...
那是你的另一种技能。
没有朋友的人一定很孤独。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
To us, relationships are very important.
You get more people, you get more help.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
对我们来说，人际关系非常重要。
认识的人越多，得到的帮助就越多。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's time to introduce myself.
I'm Dumk.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
是时候自我介绍了。
我是邓克。

scripts.text: You are...
scripts.translation: 你是...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Chicken! How about the chicken for this supper?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
小鸡！今晚的晚餐吃鸡肉怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Why chicken?
Why are you interrupting?
You wanna be fired?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
为什么是鸡肉？
你为什么插嘴？
你想被解雇吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Sorry...
 
(He turns to you and says it's taboo to talk about chicken.)
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
抱歉...

（他转向你，说谈论小鸡是禁忌。）

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Anyway, let's make a point.
You.
Will you yield to the will of the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
总之，让我们说正事。
你。
你愿意顺从刷子的意志吗？

scripts.text: Yield to? What?
scripts.translation: 顺从？什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This brush was used by the master.
Paintings by him have mysterious power.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这把刷子是师父用过的。
他画的画拥有神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
I can't tell you the root of the power.
Someday you will find out.
He sublimates power through the medium of his paintings.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我无法告诉你力量的根源。
总有一天你会明白的。
他通过画作这一媒介升华力量。

scripts.text: I don't get it...?
scripts.translation: 我不明白...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We walk in darkness without moonlight.
And find out our shining days are over.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们在没有月光的黑暗中行走。
并发现我们光辉的日子已经结束。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We follow to other shadows
and we can be real
Shadow Chasers!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们追随其他的影子，
我们才能成为真正的
逐影猎人！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
He suggests that you become a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
他建议你成为一名逐影猎人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
In our guild, there is a special group that have unique skills.
They are Shadow Chasers.
They usually hide ther figure and they think they are different from others.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
在我们的公会中，有一个拥有独特技能的特殊群体。
他们是逐影猎人。
他们通常隐藏自己的身影，并认为他们与众不同。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't be so sarcastic, Vicente!
I told you.
You are qualified to be a Shadow Chaser!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
别那么讽刺，维森特！
我告诉过你。
你有资格成为一名逐影猎人！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Give that brush to me.
I need it again.
I'm so thirsty.
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
把刷子给我。
我还需要用它。
我渴死了。
等一下。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Let me see...
Did you bring the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
让我看看...
你带刷子了吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What are you doing?
Show me the brush?
You didn't bring it?
You are not very careful...
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你在干什么？
给我看刷子？
你没带吗？
你不太仔细啊...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So, do you want me to keep talking about Shadow Chasers?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
那么，你想让我继续讲关于逐影猎人的事吗？

scripts.text: What is a Shadow Chaser?
scripts.translation: 什么是逐影猎人？

scripts.text: Change me to Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation: 让我成为逐影猎人。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Most spells are exclusively for Wizards and their kind.
But Knight has since been able to use a kind of magic with things called Runes.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
大多数法术是巫师及其同类专属的。
但骑士后来也能使用一种被称为符文的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So we tried finding a medium for spells that suit our characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
